message.content:
This editorial illustration is the cover of Tempo magazine, featuring a red background and a central circular frame. At the top, white text reads "MAJU MUNDUR ATURAN IMPOR GULA / KONTROVERSI IZIN PRAKTEK DOKTER ASING." Below, the word "TEMPO" is printed in large, black, serif capital letters above the tagline "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU." The main headline in bold white letters is "SETELAH RIZIEQ KEMBALI," followed by smaller white text: "Hampir empat tahun mengungsi ke Arab Saudi, Rizieq Syihab akhirnya kembali. Intelijen diduga ikut bermain."

The circular illustration shows four people. On the right, a man with glasses, a white turban, and a white robe stands with his left hand in his pocket. A second man, wearing a white cap and a green-and-white garment, is bent over, kissing the standing man’s right hand. Behind them, two figures in black niqabs are seated at a table. One figure holds a white smartphone with four visible camera lenses, pointing it toward the foreground. On the table sits a golden lamp shaped like an oil lamp, a green tablecloth, and three yellow plates containing small black oval objects. The bottom right includes the date "16-22 NOVEMBER 2020," a price, a barcode, and a QR code.
